_comment: THE FIRST MEASUREMENT OF rosebud.ai EVER TAKEN IN THIS REPOSITORY.
docs/FINISH-REPORT-100.md §3.6 recorded the hole: `git ls-files | grep -ci '.har$'` -> 0,
`find . -iname '*rosebud*'` -> 0 results. The owner has asked for this site to be copied,
in green, for weeks, and every design decision made in its name was made from memory.
Captured 2026-09-21 from a real browser at https://rosebud.ai, 1024x768, dpr 1, logged out,
via getComputedStyle and getBoundingClientRect. Only what was read is written down. The
signed-in editor was NOT captured and nothing here describes it.
THE HEADLINE, AND IT CONTRADICTS THE BRIEF: rosebud.ai's landing page has NO CSS
ANIMATION. Zero elements with an animationName. No <audio>, no audio file in the resource
timeline, no AudioContext. The 'spectacular background animation' and the keyboard-click
button sound are not on this page. Whatever it does to a visitor, it does without them.

typography._comment: ONE TYPEFACE FOR THE WHOLE PAGE, AND IT IS A MONOSPACE. Every h1, p, button, a, span and textarea measured returned the same stack. This is the single strongest thing about the design and the cheapest to adopt.

inlineLink.note: underlined, white — NOT the accent colour

motion._comment: Transitions only. The two durations that account for almost everything are 0.15s and 0.2s, both ease-out. Nothing on this page runs longer than 0.26s.

dominantTransitions.property: background, background-color, border-color, box-shadow, color, fill, filter, opacity, stroke, transform

againstOurLanding._comment: Same script, same browser, same 1024x768, run against https://apple.moshe-barami111.workers.dev/ at buildSha 46cd186 immediately afterwards.
readAcross: MOTION IS NOT THE GAP. Ours animates 56 elements across 10 named keyframes (stratum-drift, settle, column-breathe, caret-blink, stagger-in, rise-in, slide-in-*, step-focus, example-turn). Rosebud animates none. 'Make it move like rosebud' cannot be done, because rosebud does not move.

TYPE IS THE GAP. One monospace for everything against our two families. Their h1 is 32px/700 with POSITIVE 1.6px tracking; ours is 51.2px/400 with NEGATIVE 1.024px tracking — the opposite decision on both axes.
LENGTH IS A GAP. 2,450px against our 6,353px. Theirs is one screen and a composer; ours is two and a half times longer.
BLACK IS A GAP, BARELY. rgb(0,0,0) against rgb(5,8,7) — three points of green in the floor. Visible only side by side.
THE ACCENT IS USED THREE WAYS, NOT ONE: a solid fill on the primary button, a 12% tint with a 38% border and a 12px glow on the secondary, and never on inline links, which stay white and underlined.
